products.name: You.com Enterprise
products.note: Private search AI; no tracking; enterprise deployment; data privacy focus

profile_text.body:
You.com is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as a provider of web search APIs designed for AI applications, offering the ability to search the web, extract clean content, and generate grounded answers for AI agents and large language models. It positions its products around accuracy, freshness, and low latency for what it calls next-generation AI agents.

The company tracks two main products: You.com, a search-augmented LLM available to general users, and You.com Enterprise, a private search AI offering aimed at businesses with a focus on data privacy and no user tracking. The enterprise product is described as suitable for private deployment environments where data handling is a priority.

The held facts note no litigation or MCP registry presence on file for the company.
